name: VoiceStudio
use_label: Voice cloning and dubbing on your PC
one_liner: Clones voices, dubs video and transcribes audio on your own machine.

text.why: Working with voice usually starts by uploading the original recording to somebody else's service. voicestudio keeps cloning, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook production on the machine in front of you, so the audio never leaves it. The repository states coverage of 646 languages; it is written in Python and published under AGPL-3.0. It is self-hosted, so the runtime environment is yours to prepare.
text.take: If you want voice cloning, dubbing and dictation without sending audio to a service, start here.
build: A dubbing workflow that stays in-house with no external upload
An internal tool that transcribes meeting recordings
An audiobook line that reads your scripts in a brand voice

who.situation: dubs and transcribes without uploading audio elsewhere
needs voice prompts or audiobooks made in-house
wants a local, OpenAI-compatible speech API
